title: Captain Phasma
subtitle: First Order
description: Wearing armor crafted from the salvaged chromium of a Naboo starship, Captain Phasma started from humble beginnings and clawed her way to the top of the First Order's legion of Stormtroopers. A steadfast survivor, she betrayed the First Order in the battle at Starkiller Base and tried to cover her tracks carefully, eventually confronting her former student, FN-2187, in a battle to the death.
